entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: Enormous cyclops of Ravnica, largest and angriest leader of the Gruul Clans, leader of the Burning Tree clan.

entities.name: Burning Tree clan
entities.description: Largest and most diverse of the Gruul Clans, led by Borborygmos.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon for whom Borborygmos attended the guild summit and who was resurrected as the new Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who urged Domri to challenge Borborygmos.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Planeswalker who defeated Borborygmos with beasts and later died in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Leader of the group that persuaded Borborygmos to aid the guilds.

entities.name: Rat
entities.description: Child of prominent Gruul warriors for whom Borborygmos showed fondness.

entities.name: Fblthp
entities.description: Homunculus rescued by Borborygmos, who then fought alongside him.

entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: Leader of the Zhur-Taa Clan, the only potential challenge to Borborygmos.

entities.name: Cisarzim
entities.description: Gruul Parun from whom Borborygmos is allegedly descended.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Army fought during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that broke through on Ravnica.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Area where Borborygmos lived as a Trog hermit.

events.summary: As a favor to Niv-Mizzet, Borborygmos attends the guild summit for the Gruul, costing him respect among his people.
events.quote: This cost him much respect and honor amongst his people, for whom cooperation was anathema.

events.summary: At Bolas's urging, Domri defeats the aging Borborygmos with waves of beasts; he is not killed but loses respect and lives as a Trog in the Rubblebelt.
events.quote: Afterward, he lived as a Trog (hermit) in the Rubblebelt.

events.summary: Borborygmos acts as guildmaster again after Domri's death and is convinced by Kaya's group to aid the guilds against the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: He was convinced by Kaya 's group to aid the guilds in the fight against the Dreadhorde .

events.summary: Borborygmos represents the Gruul at the resurrection of Niv-Mizzet as the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: He served as the representative for the Gruul at the resurrection of Niv-Mizzet

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Borborygmos rescues Fblthp from Phyrexianized Golgari, and they fight together.
events.quote: Luckily, he was rescued by Borborygmos, who happened to be smashing Phyrexians nearby.

relations.quote: Borborygmos led the Burning Tree clan
he is often considered to be its Guildmaster
the planeswalker Domri Rade challenged and defeated the aging Borborygmos
making them an unstoppable duo in Ravnica's defense
